'''Branger''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] serving as a Stims Vendor in the [[Outpost Rennar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He wore blue [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].
